sources: https://secure.rec1.com/WY/natrona-county-wy/catalog (Natrona County Parks Rec1 catalog, read 2026-11-20 via its public getTabs/getItems/getLocationFacilities JSON): tab 'Pathfinder Reservoir': 'Pathfinder Reservoir now offers one reservation only campground - Diabase, all the other campgrounds are still first come, first served.'; 'Restroom facilities are provided at each Pathfinder Reservoir Campground.'; group 'Diabase': 'Reservation Only. Diabase is located off of Natrona County Road 409 to the west of Pathfinder Dam. Newly improved in 2023 Diabase Campground features 40' long concrete pads, 12' shelters, fire rings and picnic tables at each out of 11 sites. Restroom facilities are available. There are 2 ADA accessible campsites with beautiful views. Diabase campground is located closest to the boat ramp, dock, and the Pathfinder Marina. Water levels vary greatly at Pathfinder Reservoir. Campsites may be at the waters' edge one year and 1,500 feet away from the water another year. $13.39 a day plus taxes and fees.'; facilities 'DB Site 01'-'DB Site 11' (04 and 11 'ADA Accessible'), each 'Nightly Rate' $13.39 for 2026-01-01..2026-12-31; site photos are sign-post close-ups reading 'DB n / 10 DAY CAMPING LIMIT / ENJOY YOUR STAY / RESERVATIONS REQUIRED'; directions link -> Google 'Diabase Campground' 42.4689469,-106.8705174
